rows.required: Actual generated consumer AOT and packed/native list/form-control behavior; source protocol states are not execution of Angular/forms.

rows.current_canonical_assertion: Normal Angular initialization and a live public CDK direction emission must first reach the actual legacy field. Two more direction emissions are queued before actual embedded-view destruction. Two native frames later, destruction/removal and zero late public updater calls are required. The original updater always forwards; no forced render or new matrix id.
